Soft pieces

Green pasta with cheese

Zöld tészta sajttal

8 months+ Adjusted 25 min 4 portions

Cut or mash any piece that does not squash, and serve warm rather than hot. Stir the yogurt in just before eating.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 100 g small pasta (dry weight, cooked until very soft)
  • 60 g spinach (washed, tough stems removed)
  • 100 g broccoli (small florets)
  • 1 small clove garlic (finely chopped)
  • 1 tsp olive oil (for the garlic and greens)
  • 1 tbsp plain yogurt (pasteurized, unsweetened)
  • 10 g mild hard cheese (pasteurized, finely grated)

Allergens

glutenmilk

Method

  1. Boil the pasta in unsalted water until very soft, then drain it.
  2. Cook the garlic in the olive oil for under a minute without browning it hard.
  3. Add the broccoli and spinach with a splash of water and cook until they mash easily.
  4. Chop or mash the greens and toss them through the pasta.
  5. Stir in the yogurt and the cheese off the heat, and do not add salt.

Adjusted

The usual plate was salted and very rich with a cup of cream, and it was often served around 11 months. A pinch of salt and that much cream are unnecessary for a baby.

Use soft pasta with spinach, broccoli, and a little garlic cooked in olive oil. Stir in one spoon of plain yogurt and a little pasteurized cheese, and add no salt.
